name: PinnedRoadmapCards
description: An editorial vertical roadmap of zig-zag rotated polaroid-framed pastel cards with tactile paper grain, etched notebook ruled lines, 3D glossy pushpins with wobble physics, curved dashed SVG connectors, and an interactive checklist with live note pinning.

checkpoints.name: v1: Initial AI Creation
checkpoints.description: An editorial zig-zag pinned roadmap of pastel polaroid-style step cards with 3D glossy pushpins, curved dashed SVG connectors, notebook ruled lines, and interactive hover-straighten & checklist toggles.

checkpoints.name: v2: Upgraded paper grain & etched ruled-line texture, realistic 3D pushpin subsurface glow & wobble physics, expanded to 7 curated note pins with live Pin Another Note composer and textureIntensity/cardCount controls.
